title: Upload Admin
desc: Audit trail of every upload. Failed papers don't appear in History, but their filename and error are always queryable here, and the original file can be downloaded to reproduce the failure locally.
tokenHint: The token is set by the backend ADMIN_TOKEN; once entered it is remembered in this browser.
disabled: Admin disabled: the server has not set ADMIN_TOKEN.
downloadFailed: Download failed (the file may no longer be on the server).
